name: Ittan-momen
description: Ittan-momen (一反木綿, 'one bolt of cotton') is a dangerous yokai from Kagoshima Prefecture in southern Japan, appearing as a long white strip of cotton cloth that flies through the night sky and kills humans by wrapping around their heads and necks.

aliases.name: 一反木綿
aliases.meaning: One bolt of cotton / one tan of cotton cloth

origin: Originating in Kōyama, Kimotsuki District, Kagoshima Prefecture, southern Kyushu. Modern sightings reported more broadly across Kyushu, Tokyo, and Shizuoka.
